description: This file defines the UsersTester class, which extends AcceptanceTester and provides methods for navigating to a user's profile and logging out a user within the test suite.

classes.name: UsersTester
classes.description: A test helper class providing user navigation actions within acceptance tests.

methods.name: gotoProfile
methods.description: Navigates to the user's profile module by clicking on the 'Profile' menu item.

methods.name: logoutUser
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clicking on the logout link.
